observations.observation: Original has no h1 and its heading outline starts with an h2 reading 'Main Content'. Its title is 'Home - The Frangipani Creative'. The AI-built page has a single h1, 'The Frangipani Creative', set at 96px, weight 600, in white Cormorant Garamond over the hero and broken across three lines. Its title is 'The Frangipani Creative'.

tags.value: changed: absent h1 becomes large white serif h1
changed: plain page title becomes branded title

observations.observation: Original's heading hierarchy is irregular. It jumps from h2 to h4, has an empty h2, uses placeholder headings such as 'Main Content', 'Before Footer' and 'Footer', and repeats 'FOLLOW ME ON SOCIAL MEDIA' as both an h3 and an h4. The AI-built page runs h1 to h2 to h3 without skipping a level, with 7 h2s and 3 h3s, and its testimonial names are h3s rather than h2s.

tags.value: changed: flat irregular outline becomes structured h1 h2 h3

observations.observation: Original's header is centered on white: a serif wordmark above a thin rule, then a centered nav row. The AI-built header is a translucent cream bar with backdrop blur, overlaid on the hero 181px from the top, with the wordmark on the left and the nav on the right.

tags.value: changed: separate inset bar becomes translucent blurred header nav
changed: backdrop blur on header

observations.observation: Both pages show the brand name as plain text in a serif face rather than as an image or SVG logo. Original uses Arbutus Slab and the AI-built page uses Cormorant Garamond.

tags.value: kept: text wordmark in serif face

observations.observation: Original's header nav has 7 bold title-case links of about 15–16px: Home, Blog, The Frangipani Creative Podcast, Happy Clients, Contact, Archives and Books I Recommend. The active 'Home' item is crimson. The AI-built header nav has 5 links on the right, and observers note no active state for it.

tags.value: changed: seven bold links become five right-aligned links
changed: crimson active home item

observations.observation: Original pairs Open Sans (379 elements) for body text with the Arbutus Slab slab serif (23 elements) for headings. It also uses Helvetica on the social buttons and the FontAwesome and sw-icon-font icon fonts. The AI-built page pairs Nunito Sans (148 elements) for body and UI with the high-contrast serif Cormorant Garamond (25 elements) for display text, and has no icon fonts.

tags.value: changed: open sans and slab serif become nunito sans and cormorant
changed: icon fonts for social and ui glyphs

observations.observation: Original sets body text at 18px with a 29.25px line height (about 1.625). The AI-built page sets it at 17px with a 28.05px line height (about 1.65).

tags.attribute: body text size and line height
tags.value: changed: 18px 1.625 becomes 17px 1.65

observations.observation: Original's h2s are small and light, at 30px and weight 400. The AI-built h2s are large and heavier, at 46.4px and weight 600, under a 96px h1.

tags.value: changed: small light h2s become large bold serif h2s

observations.observation: Original centers its section headings ('Personalized Blog Coaching', 'Happy Clients', post titles). The AI-built page left-aligns the text of its hero, service, testimonial and contact sections, and centers only the content inside the Instagram tiles and the social pills.

tags.value: changed: centered headings become left-aligned text

observations.observation: Original's palette is pure black text on a white body, with a single crimson accent, rgb(178,3,50), used on 106 elements. The AI-built palette is warm: plum-black text rgb(43,34,38) on a cream body rgb(253,248,243), near-black sections, blush-pink panels, a crimson accent rgb(194,37,92) and an amber secondary accent rgb(232,163,61).

tags.value: changed: black and white with crimson becomes warm cream with crimson and amber
changed: crimson accent gains amber secondary

observations.observation: Both pages underline their body links and color them crimson. Original uses rgb(178,3,50) and the AI-built page uses rgb(194,37,92).

tags.value: kept: underlined crimson body links

observations.observation: Original's social links are full-width, rounded buttons in each brand's color (Facebook blue, Instagram pink-red, LinkedIn blue, Pinterest red, Twitter light blue). Each has an icon glyph, a Helvetica label and a white 'Like' or 'Follow' pill. The AI-built social links are five neutral outline pills, each with the platform name followed by a muted 'Like' or 'Follow' in a nested <small>.

tags.value: changed: brand colored buttons become neutral outline pills

observations.observation: Original's social-button icons render as stray letters (k, q, s, A, N) because the sw-icon-font glyphs are not mapped. The AI-built page has no icon fonts and no SVGs.

tags.value: dropped: stray letter glyphs in social buttons

observations.observation: Original opens with an intro boxed to the 880px column. It sits on a blurred brown bokeh photo with a pink frangipani, carries black text with low contrast, and leaves a large empty gap before a 'Read this' link. The AI-built page opens with a 756px-tall, full-bleed, dark-overlaid frangipani hero with a white h1 and two CTAs.

tags.value: changed: boxed intro on bokeh photo becomes full-bleed dark overlay hero

observations.observation: The AI-built page has a two-column About section. The left column holds an eyebrow label, an h2 and paragraphs. The right column is a list of 5 bio items separated by hairline rules, each with a crimson flower-glyph bullet (15 emoji in the AI-built text compared with 1 in the original).

tags.value: added: two-column about with bio list

observations.observation: The AI-built page has a pale-pink rounded callout, rgb(249,223,230), saying that programs and events are coming soon. It has no heading and no icon.

tags.value: added: pale pink rounded coming soon callout

observations.observation: Original shows testimonials as black text over a near-black floral background photo, with a white hairline divider. The AI-built page shows three equal white cards, each 331x505 with a thin border and large radius, containing stars, a date, body text, an h3 name and two small links.

tags.value: changed: text over dark photo becomes three white cards

observations.observation: Original exposes raw structured-data fields as visible text in its testimonial block. These include the rating '5', the ISO timestamp '2019-10-15T11:24:24+05:30', a duplicated quote, the testimonial URL and stray numbers.

tags.value: dropped: raw structured data text visible

observations.observation: Original's testimonial ratings are five black FontAwesome star icons. The AI-built ratings are the amber text glyphs '★★★★★', with the same stars and the same date '15 October 2019' on every card.

tags.value: changed: icon stars become amber text glyph stars

observations.observation: The AI-built testimonials paraphrase the clients in the third person ('She had long struggled…', 'He felt like a lone fish…') rather than quoting them.

tags.value: added: third-person paraphrased testimonials

observations.observation: Original has 15 elements. All of them are 1x1 transparent lazy-load GIF placeholders, so the thumbnail slots render blank and the visible photos come from CSS backgrounds. The AI-built page has 0 and 0 SVG elements, and all of its imagery comes from CSS backgrounds.

tags.value: changed: placeholder img elements become css backgrounds only

observations.observation: Original's coaching block is a centered card with a blank 300x300 image slot, a teaser and an inline crimson 'Read more..' text link. The AI-built version is a full-width (1440px) dark photo banner with a left-aligned white serif h2, one sentence and a crimson 'Read more' pill.

tags.value: changed: centered card becomes full-width dark photo banner
changed: inline text link becomes crimson pill

observations.observation: Original shows recent posts as a 4-column row of about 180px cards. Each has an empty thumbnail, a centered serif title and a 'By NAME' byline with an italic 'By' and spaced, uppercase, bold gray names. The AI-built page shows a 1040px-wide list of 5 rows divided by hairlines, with a serif title on the left and a small gray 'by Lux'-style author on the right.

tags.value: changed: four-column card row becomes hairline row list

observations.observation: The AI-built page has a line of text links under the blog list, 'Authors: Lux · Fabida Abdulla · Blog · Archives · Podcast', separated by middots.

tags.value: added: middot separated authors and links line

observations.observation: Both pages use a photo of frangipani blossoms against a blue sky. Original uses it as the background of a three-column widget band (social follow, location, recent posts). The AI-built page shows it as a standalone 1040x260 rounded banner with no text, placed above the Instagram section.

tags.value: changed: widget band background becomes standalone rounded banner

observations.observation: Original uses small, bold, letter-spaced uppercase labels only for the widget column headings ('LOCATION', 'RECENT POSTS'), with 'FOLLOW ME ON SOCIAL MEDIA' in serif. The AI-built page puts a letter-spaced uppercase eyebrow div above every section's h2: crimson on light sections and amber on dark ones.

tags.value: changed: uppercase letterspaced eyebrow above headings

observations.observation: Original gives the Secunderabad address and its mobile and landline numbers as plain text in a widget column. The AI-built page has a dark two-column contact section with an <address> element and a <dl> of uppercase labels (MOBILE, LANDLINE, ONLINE, READING LIST), with light-pink underlined links.

tags.value: changed: plain text widget becomes dark two-column contact with address and dl

observations.observation: The AI-built dark contact and footer areas use white, muted pink-white rgb(244,235,230) and light-pink link text, with small letter-spaced uppercase labels.

tags.value: added: light pink text and links on dark bands

observations.observation: Original has a widget column of recent-post links in underlined crimson, including '20 Quotes To Encourage You To Be A Fearless Writer'.

tags.value: dropped: widget list of recent post links

observations.observation: Original has a fixed white cookie consent bar with a 'Cookie Policy' link and a gray 'Close and accept' button.

tags.value: dropped: fixed cookie consent bar

observations.observation: Original's Instagram feed renders broken. A giant crimson Instagram SVG about 745px wide appears twice, with truncated, underlined caption links between the two copies. The AI-built feed is a 4-column grid of 8 square 248px tiles in flat pink, dark or amber, each with a serif caption at the bottom left.

tags.value: changed: broken giant glyph becomes grid of text-only tiles

observations.observation: Original's content sits in a column about 880px wide (x=280–1160). The AI-built content sits in a column 1040px wide (x=200–1240). Both are centered on a 1440px canvas.

tags.value: changed: 880px column becomes wider 1040px column

observations.observation: Original breaks its centered column with the Instagram section, which is left-aligned at x≈97 under an h3 'thefrangipanicreative'. In the AI-built page, the Instagram section stays in the column and the only offset is the hero h1 column at x=491.

tags.value: changed: offset instagram section becomes in-column section

observations.observation: Original keeps a white outer page with wide empty margins, and its background-image sections are boxed to the 880px column. The AI-built page alternates full-width cream, white and dark (rgb(23,18,20)) section bands, with hairline borders between some light sections.

tags.value: changed: white page becomes alternating cream white and dark bands

observations.observation: Both pages end with an affiliate disclosure and a '© 2020 The Frangipani Creative' line. Original sets them in a plain white footer with a hairline rule and a centered copyright. The AI-built footer continues the dark band, with a hairline, the copyright (with an en dash), the disclosure and a row of 6 underlined nav links.

tags.value: changed: white footer becomes dark band with nav links

observations.observation: Neither page uses box shadows or gradient backgrounds, so depth comes from flat color and borders.

tags.value: kept: no shadows or gradients

observations.observation: Original is almost entirely square-cornered, with 435 elements at 0 radius and only 5 at 16px or more, mostly the social buttons. The AI-built page rounds its cards, tiles, pills and callouts, with 22 elements at 16px or more and 150 at 0. The AI-built page also uses one backdrop blur, on the header, where the original uses none.

tags.value: changed: square corners become pills and large radii
changed: backdrop blur on header

observations.observation: Original's only button is a square black 'Menu' mobile toggle (padding 16px 24px), and its calls to action are inline text links such as 'Read more..'. The AI-built page has 0 <button> elements. Its calls to action are anchor pills with a 99px radius in sentence case, solid crimson or outlined: 'Personalized blog coaching', 'Get in touch', 'Read more', 'All happy clients' and 'Follow on Instagram'.

tags.value: changed: text links become solid and outline pill buttons
changed: square black menu toggle

observations.observation: Original lays out with floats and block flow, using 0 grid and 6 flex containers across 167 divs. The AI-built page uses 4 grid and 25 flex containers across 48 divs.

tags.value: changed: floats and fixed widths become flex plus grid

observations.observation: Original is a long scroll of 7,381px with 622 words. Its sections run: intro, coaching card, testimonials, recent posts, widgets, Instagram, footer. The AI-built page is 5,546px with 546 words and about 80px of section padding. Its sections run: hero, about, service, testimonials, blog, Instagram, social, contact, footer.

tags.value: changed: very tall page becomes much shorter page
changed: large blank gaps become regular section padding

observations.observation: Original is WordPress-style markup. It has 49 scripts, 15 stylesheets, 11 style blocks, 53 inline style attributes, 4 iframes, 35 meta tags including Open Graph, Twitter and generator tags, and 1 JSON-LD block. The AI-built page has 0 scripts, 1 stylesheet, 2 inline style attributes, 3 meta tags and no JSON-LD.

tags.value: changed: cms heavy markup becomes minimal markup
changed: rich social and json-ld meta becomes minimal meta

observations.observation: Both pages use custom class names with almost no utility classes (Tailwind-like fraction 1.3% in the original and 1.4% in the AI-built page). The sizes differ: 621 class uses across 210 unique classes in the original, and 71 uses across 30 unique classes in the AI-built page.

tags.value: kept: custom class names rather than utility classes

observations.observation: Original has 7 header elements, 1 nav, 1 main, 13 sections, 7 articles, 1 footer and 1 figure with a figcaption. The AI-built page has 1 header, 2 navs, 1 main, 7 sections, 3 articles and 1 footer, uses address and dl for contact details, and has no figure. Neither page uses aside elements.

tags.value: changed: many headers and sections become single header and fewer sections

observations.observation: Original has 21 ARIA attributes. Its images all carry alt attributes, but many are empty and the Instagram images hold long captions as alt text. The AI-built page has 4 ARIA attributes and no images at all.

tags.value: changed: empty and caption alts become no images

observations.observation: Original's copy is first-person from the coach, with a fragmented bio ('A lover of words. A self-acceptance blogger.') and calls to action such as 'Read this' and 'Load More...'. The AI-built copy talks about the named coach in the third person and adds the eyebrow 'SECUNDERABAD, INDIA'. Neither page uses exclamation marks or em dashes.

tags.value: changed: first-person copy becomes third-person

observations.observation: Original defines 58 transitions, 1 animation and 5 transforms. The AI-built page defines 10 transitions and no animations or transforms.

tags.value: changed: many transitions become fewer transitions
